data.title: Lionel Messi's father Jorge dies aged 68
data.description: BUENOS AIRES (ARGENTINA) - Jorge Messi, the father and agent of Lionel Messi, has died aged 68, the eight-time Ballon d'Or winner's childhood club Newell's Old Boys announced on Saturday.

data.title: Infantino denies allegations of affair, favouritism while at UEFA: report

data.title: Ukraine denies targeting Bulgaria as drone explodes near pipeline

data.title: Drone explodes near gas pipeline in Bulgaria

data.title: Arsenal sign midfielder Guimaraes from Newcastle
